visualReview.method: Native advancing playback captured at pose changes; chronological source-size boards for all 30 groups visually inspected, plus initial native source/baseline/station view. GIFs preserve observed cadence for owner review. This is not a claim of continuously watched gameplay.
findings: No new major clipping or proportion defects observed in reviewed poses.
Diagnostics: visible cyan tablet, coherent grip, canonical head and boots retained.
Cargo and loaded water turns: connected hands/case and coherent directional progression; no obvious new material flashes in consecutive poses.
Run/rest/recovery: readable pose progression; authored sparse frame counts and timing retained.
North ground shutdown: paired legs behind body. White injury fluid retained.
limits: Capture overhead affects observed GIF cadence; GIF centiseconds round timing.
Review-sequence restart is not an authored loop seam or gameplay transition.
World movement, foot sliding and furniture occlusion require live station context; not established by this fixture.

profileIsolation: All invocations explicitly set scratch APPDATA. A fresh before/after real-profile fingerprint was not captured for this review pass; unchanged owner-profile contents are not asserted.
capturePolicy: Primary 27-group playback plus corrected supplemental travel/aliases. Primary travel images were superseded after supplemental filename collision; supplement uses separate names. Primary terminal queued draw raised an out-of-bounds error after capture completion; bounds guard corrected and supplemental run verified.
